title: 第 1 章 你要老公不要？
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【善良的玩家哦，你要老公不要？】

【如果痴情剑尊、霸道妖王、邪魅魔尊、温柔仙君、病娇鲛人、白切黑龙族少主同时追杀你，你会选择谁？】

“什么脑残广告？”昭杺柠捧着手机无语。

一目十行的她，只看见各种符合自己喜好的男主人设，全然忽略了最后面，被刻意缩小了很多倍的‘杀’字。

玩遍恋爱游戏的昭杺柠，一边唾弃现在恋爱游戏都这样打广告了吗，手却很诚实点进了广告链接。

昭杺柠激情点进广告，直接跳出七个美男绘画，还有各种深情温柔的台词。

“未婚妻是魔又如何？”无情道剑修半跪在地，流血的手紧握手中剑，死死护住身后女子：“如果你是魔，那我就改修魔道，逆了这天道！”

“姐姐，还是想逃吗？”巫族少主指尖符箓燃烧，映照在火光中染血的唇勾笑：“你是逃不掉的。”

“跟我回龙界吧，我们成亲。”龙族少年清澈的金眸带满眷念，深情呼唤：“我的龙族新娘。”

“人类都是感情上的骗子。”鲛人皇身后掀起千帆巨浪，死寂无情的紫眸却暗藏柔情：“如果是你，我心甘情愿被骗。”

“我愿以魔界为聘。”魔尊单膝跪拜，深情伸手，含情脉脉呼唤：“我的魔后，我们回家。”

“妖族领域人类止步。”妖族少主雾蓝双眸杀意瞬间转为深情：“但你，是我唯一的例外。”

“忘记我了吗，可我一直在寻你。”温柔仙君哭得梨花带雨，可怜泣声：“明明是你先招惹我的……”

看着一张又一张美男图从自己眼前划过，听着一句又一句深情的告白。

昭杺柠惊喜：“所以说这些男主同时追我？小孩子才做选择，我可是成年人了……”

“当然是全都要啊！”

昭杺柠只需要一眼，就知道这些男主都是她失散多年的老公。

而宣传海报上，不管是无情道剑修、妖族少主、龙族少年、巫族少主、深情魔尊、哭包仙君都在绝美绘画上，敞开衣襟疯狂勾引她。

这一幕更是激起昭杺柠想要allin的冲动，急忙进入游戏。

刚进入游戏，昭杺柠就发现自己的形象是个火柴人。

游戏提示，火柴人代表玩家。

而昭杺柠作为玩家，需要用线将选择追（杀）她的男主，跟代表自己的火柴人连在一起，才能正式开始游戏。

昭杺柠连线的时候，嫌弃系统默认的黑线不吉利。

所以昭杺柠自己更换了红色的线，用来链接自己和男主们。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

[Kind player, do you want a husband or not?】

[If the infatuated sword master, the domineering demon king, the evil demon king, the gentle fairy king, the sickly shark, and the young master of the black dragon clan of Baiqie are chasing you at the same time, who will you choose?】

"What kind of stupid advertisement?" Zhao Hao Ning was speechless while holding her phone.

At a glance, she only saw various male protagonists that suited her preferences, completely ignoring the word 'kill' at the end, which was deliberately reduced many times.

Zhao Hao Ning, who has played all the love games, scorned whether all love games are advertised like this now, but she honestly clicked on the advertising link.

Zhao Hao Ning clicked into the advertisement passionately, and seven paintings of beautiful men jumped out directly, as well as various affectionate and tender lines.

"So what if my fiancée is a demon?" The Qingqing Dao sword cultivator half-knelt on the ground, holding the sword tightly with his bleeding hand, protecting the woman behind him: "If you are a demon, then I will change to the demonic path and go against the way of heaven!"

"Sister, do you still want to escape?" The talisman at the fingertips of the young master of the Wu clan burned, and his blood-stained lips smiled in the firelight: "You can't escape."

"Come back to the dragon world with me, and we will get married." The clear golden eyes of the dragon boy were full of nostalgia, and he called affectionately: "My dragon bride."

"Human beings are all emotional liars." The Merman Emperor set off a thousand sails and huge waves behind him, but his lifeless purple eyes concealed tenderness: "If it were you, I would be willing to be deceived."

"I am willing to be employed by the devil." The devil knelt down on one knee, stretched out his hand affectionately, and called lovingly: "My devil queen, let's go home."

"Humanity has stopped in the demon clan domain." The misty blue eyes of the young master of the demon clan instantly turned to affectionate murderous intent: "But you are my only exception."

"Have you forgotten me? But I have been looking for you." Gentle Immortal Lord cried so hard that she cried pitifully: "It was obviously you who provoked me first..."

Watching pictures of beautiful men passing by one after another, listening to affectionate confessions one after another.

Zhao Hao Ning was surprised: "So these male protagonists are chasing me at the same time? Only children make choices, I am an adult..."

"Of course I want them all!"

Zhao Hao Ning only needed one glance to know that these male protagonists were her long-lost husbands.

On the promotional posters, the ruthless sword cultivator, the young master of the demon clan, the young boy of the dragon clan, the young master of the witch clan, the affectionate demon lord, and the crybaby fairy are all depicted in beautiful paintings, opening their clothes to seduce her crazily.

This scene aroused Zhao Hao Ning's urge to allin, and she hurriedly entered the game.

As soon as she entered the game, Zhao Hao Ning discovered that her image was that of a stickman.

Game Tips: The stick figure represents the player.

As a player, Zhao Hao Ning needs to use a thread to connect the male protagonist who chooses to chase (kill) her with the stick figure representing herself before the game can officially start.

When Zhao Hao Ning connected, she felt that the system's default black line was unlucky.

So Zhao Hao Ning changed the red thread to connect herself with the male protagonists.
